KRS Chess Help shows its button and the suggested move on top of your chess app. Allow “Display over other apps” for KRS Chess Help, then come back and press Start.

Without a Claude API key the app cannot read a board from the screen with Claude. It can only suggest moves from its small built-in engine, which is much weaker and works only while it can follow the game from the starting position.

What this app does while it is running:

• It captures your screen. Stop it from the floating panel, the notification or this screen.

• It sends the image of the chess board to Anthropic's API to be analysed. If “Send a full-screen screenshot” is on, a downscaled picture of your whole screen is sent too, including anything else visible on it.

• Requests are made with your own API key. Every analysis costs money, charged by Anthropic to your account.

Fair play: this app is meant for study, puzzles, analysis and games against bots. Using move assistance in live games against other people breaks the rules of chess sites and can get your account closed.
